pages.name: Griffin
pages.text: HYBRID. 180 HP, base damage 11. Four legs, a deep chest and articulated feathered wings spanning about 8.5 blocks.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: A rare solitary predator of open peaks, rocks and high meadows above Y=80, including BOP crag, highland and rocky shrubland. Needs open sky, wing clearance and firm support. Does not spawn in cramped caves.

pages.title: Ground combat
pages.text: Claws: 11 damage; beak: 13; broad wing strike: 9 with strong knockback. Sidestep after its windup. Below 30 percent health it pursues and dives faster.

pages.title: Air
pages.text: Takeoff, a bounded circuit and a warning before its 16-damage dive. The dive commits before launch: dodge late rather than retreating in a straight line. Every aerial cycle ends; grounded cooldowns keep the beast accessible.

pages.title: Force it down
pages.text: Deal 18 cumulative actual damage during one flight to interrupt it and force a landing. It then takes 30 percent extra damage for 3 seconds. Walls and low roofs obstruct flight. Hybrid oil boosts weapon damage by 20 percent for 30 hits.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: 1–2 hybrid essences; 80 percent feather chance (1–3), claw 40, trophy 3. Trophy requires a player or tamed ally kill. Essence, feather and claw craft hybrid oil.

pages.title: Hunting lures
pages.text: $(l:hunting_lures)Hunting lures$(/l) can call this creature. Read the placement, waiting and cooldown rules before setting an offering.
